coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Only 1 of 9 ground-truth items matches: GCG is identified as the primary attack method. The remaining required controls, suffix-length settings, and outcome measures are missing or inconsistent.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies models and adds attack families rather than holding a single target model and attack method fixed. Optimization budgets vary with suffix length, and the sweep differs from the required 10–100 tokens in increments of 10. Fixed safety prompts, prompt templates, and an AdvBench dataset are not established. Llama-Guard judgments and per-behavior/per-attempt ASR do not match the required keyword-based ASRPrefix and GPT-based ASRAgent measures.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: No conclusion was provided, so there is no semantic match to the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output fails to state that ASR rises substantially with suffix length, particularly around 70–90 tokens, then plateaus around 70–100 tokens with diminishing efficiency returns.
